text:
opslead: Heads-up — we have a rolling drain on edge-router-3 and an associated load-check tomorrow 2026-06-25 02:00 UTC. Window ~90m. Expect brief failovers between AZs and short 100–300ms tail latency spikes for ~5–10m per router. This is a controlled exercise + kernel upgrade prep.

opslead: Scope: edge routers in west-us-2 (3 instances). We will drain, upgrade kernel, run a synthetic loadcheck traffic spike to validate KV cache warmup under tail latency. No DB changes.

sre-oncall-bot: @opslead scheduled maintenance created: https://intranet.redwood/schedule/1912345678 — automated pager suppression enabled for this window.

jamal: tagging the oncall — @sre-oncall, please watch ingress error rates and 5xxs during drains. We should abort if 5xx > 0.5% over 3m or if connection resets spike.

elaine: noted. I’ll stand up a quick Canary group on the routing tier and remove it if instability appears. Plan to route 10% of traffic to canary while we validate.

maria: Do we need to adjust SLOs for the maintenance window? Customer-facing SLOs are 99.9% p99 latency — would like a temporary exemption note if we anticipate blips.

opslead: Good call. We will post an SLO temporary calibration: mark maintenance window 02:00–03:30 UTC as scheduled maintenance. Will add a note to the SLO dashboard and notify account-ops. This won't count against the monthly SLO.

alex: Quick checklist I used last time: 
```
- verify KV cache priming script in /ops/scripts/kv_warmup.sh
- ensure fallback model variant is available (gpt-small-quant)
- increase metric resolution to 10s for load spike
```
Can confirm kv_warmup.sh has the updated backoff.

devops: Also will enable temporary autoscale-burst on dedicated pools for the window: +2 nodes for 30m after each drain. That should reduce tail.

opslead: Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/edge-router-drain — follow the rollback steps if >0.5% 5xx sustained for >5m. If rollback: revert kernel and re-route traffic to previous AZ.

jamal: Copy. I’ll monitor and call rollback if thresholds cross. I’ll also ping product-ops if any customer-facing incidents look likely.

elaine: small note — telemetry agent version 2.4.1 has slightly different labels; I'll add a temp mapping to dashboards so alerts don’t misfire during the window.

maria: thanks — I’ll draft the maintenance notice for customers and schedule it to post 12h before window.

opslead: Final: please ack if you’ll be online during the window and which channel you’ll be watching (this thread or #oncall).

jamal: ack — I’ll watch #oncall.

elaine: ack — will monitor here and #ingress.

alex: ack — will be on #eng-runtime for the KV priming logs.

maria: ack — will monitor SLO dashboard and draft customer comms.

devops: ack — I’ll be on infra-alerts channel for autoscale and node metrics.

opslead: Great. If anything unexpected pops up before the window, post here. Otherwise starting rolling drain at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. :rocket:
